title: Fliesenarbeien BT B Gymnasium - Erweiterung Schulzentrum Steinlach-Wiesaz in Dußlingen
description: Auf dem Areal des Schulzentrums Steinlach-Wiesaz am süd-östlichen Ortsrand von Dusslingen werden die bestehende Gemeinschaftsschule, sowie das Gymnasium in Teilbereichen umgebaut und mit drei neuen Erweiterungsschulbauten realisiert. Im Zuge der Baumaßnahme werden auch die Zugangs- und Pausenhofbereiche, sowie die Bushaltestelle neugestaltet. Im ersten Bauabschnitt wurde die Ausführung des Neubaus der Gemeinschaftsschule bearbeitet. Im aktuell zweiten Bauabschnitt sind der Abbruch des nördlichen Fachklassenbaus mit Gartenschuppen mit anschließendem Neubau des Fachklassenbaus des Karl von Frisch Gymnasiums (Bauteil B) und der Neubau des Verbindungsbaus an das bestehende Bauteil A des Gymnasiums vorgesehen. /// Bestand: Das Gymnasium besteht aus vier zweigeschossigen Baukörpern (BT A, BT B, BT C und BT D/E) sowie einem eingeschossigen Gartenschuppen. Die einzelnen Baukörper sind in Systembauweise hergestellt und deren Grundrisse basieren auf einem Raster von gleichschenkligen Dreiecken, welche wabenförmig zusammengefügt wurden. /// Die beiden südlichen Klassenbauten C und D/E sowie der nördliche Fachklassenbau B gruppieren sich um den zentralen Zugangs-, Verwaltungs- und Aulabau A. Der eingeschossige Gartenschuppen ist an den Fachklassenbau B im Bereich an dessen nordwestlicher Fassadenecke angedockt. /// Neubau: Der geplante Neubau Fachklassenbau BT B des Gymnasiums besteht aus einem zweigeschossigen rechteckigen Hauptgebäude mit einem begrünten Flachdach, das an der Fassade Süd-Ost über einen zweigeschossigen Verbindungsflur und einem neu zu erstellenden zweigeschossigen Anbau an den bestehenden Verwaltungs- und Aulabau A des Gymnasiums angeschlossen wird. Die Fachklassenräume sind in beiden Geschossen vierseitig umlaufend an den Außenfassaden Nord-West, Nord-Ost, Süd-Ost und Süd-West angeordnet, dadurch wird ein Innenhof mit einem separaten WC- Kern gebildet. Der Fachklassenneubau besteht aus einem Erd- und einem Obergeschoss, sowie einer Teilunterkellerung, in der ausschließlich die Technikzentrale untergebracht wird. Der Fachklassenneubau, inkl. dem außen vierseitig umlaufenden Fluchtbalkon im 1.OG, erstreckt sich von Süd-West nach Nord-Ost über eine Breite von ca. 40,50 m und von Süd-Ost nach Nord-West eine Länge von ca. 35,50 m. Die EG-Geschosshöhe des Schulneubaus beträgt ca. 3,90 m und im OG bis zum extensiv begrünten Flachdach mit einer Geschosshöhe von ca. 4,00 m. /// /// Diese Bekanntmachung umfasst die Leistungen für die Fliesenarbeiten des Neubaus Bauteil B Fachklassenbau Gymnasium und Neubau Verbindungsbau an das bestehende BT A.

description: Advance Procurement Notice National Supply and InStall Electronic Security Systems Source List Across Canada (Facility security clearance (FSC) SECRET) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at various locations across Canada (excluding Nunavut). The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This solicitation proposes to establish a Security Installer Supplier Services source list to deliver the activities required to meet DND objectives. The services required are the supply, installation, verification, inspection, testing of electronic security system components and systems. The provision of training and maintenance support for the new and existing systems is also required. It is anticipated that the following solicitation will select multiple contractors, who will be placed on a National Source List with DCC to provide services on an “as and when required” basis to a maximum estimated value of $3,000,000.00, for a period of three (3) years from the date of establishment. title: Rozšíření MŠ Hradisková v Jablonném nad Orlicí o dva nové pavilony
description: Jedná se o přístavbu dvou nových pavilonů MŠ, které budou sloužit pro dvě nová oddělení MŠ (přístavba ke stávající stavbě). V prostoru herny a ložnice budou v době spánku rozložena lehátka a po ukončení spánku budou opět lehátka složena a umístěna do skladu lehátek. Stravování je řešeno přípravou pokrmů ve stávající centrální kuchyni a přeprava stravy na jednotlivá oddělení je řešena v termoboxech, které se vracejí opět do hlavní kuchyně, kde jsou umývány. V prostorech bez oken, kde je větrání řešeno podtlakovým systémem, budou osazeny dveře s větrací mřížkou. Jedná se o místnosti č. 1.04, 1,10, 1,11, 1,14, 2,11, 2,13, 2,10 a 2,14. V obou pavilonech jsou všechny okenní výplně navrženy jako otvíravé z hliníkových profilů zasklené izolačním trojskly. title: Siviilipalveluskeskuksen pesulapalvelut 2027-
description: Siviilipalveluskeskuksen pesulapalvelut 2027- KEHA-keskus pyytää tarjoustanne Siviilipalveluskeskuksen pesulapalvelujen tuottamisesta. Siviilipalveluskeskuksen pesulapalvelu sisältää siviilipalvelusvelvollisten käytössä olevien liinavaatteiden noudon, pesun, kuivauksen, mankeloinnin sekä palautuksen. Liinavaatteisiin kuuluvat tyynyliinat, aluslakanat, pussilakanat ja käsipyyhkeet. Sopimuksen perusteella voidaan tarvittaessa tilata vastaavia pesulapalveluja myös tyynyjen, peittojen sekä muiden Siviilipalveluskeskuksessa käytettävien tekstiilien, kuten verhojen ja työvaatteiden, pesuun. Kaikki tekstiilit pestään niiden omien pesuohjeiden mukaisesti. Palveluntarjoaja toimittaa pyykin kuljetuksessa tarvittavat nouto- ja palautuspussit sekä rullakot tai muut kuljetusvälineet. Puhdas pyykki tulee palauttaa pusseihin tai muihin kuljetusvälineisiin pakattuna ja tekstiilityypeittäin lajiteltuna siten, että eri tekstiililajit ovat erikseen pakattuina. Pesuun toimitettavan pyykin pakkaamisesta vastaa Siviilipalveluskeskus. Likapyykkiä ei lajitella tekstiilityypeittäin ennen kuljetusta, vaan lajittelu tapahtuu pesulassa. Liinavaatteet noudetaan ja puhtaat tekstiilit palautetaan perjantaisin klo 12.00–16.00. Nouto- ja palautus tapahtuvat 1–2 viikon välein riippuen Siviilipalveluskeskuksen kulloisestakin siviilipalvelusvelvollisten määrästä. Palveluntarjoaja punnitsee pyykin kuivapainoisena ennen pesua. Pyykin määrä on arviolta 50–300 kg viikossa, mutta yksittäisinä viikkoina määrä voi olla tätä suurempi tai pienempi. Ilmoitettu arvio ei sido tilaajaa, eikä palveluntarjoajalla ole oikeutta korvaukseen, mikäli pyykin määrä jää alle 300 kilogramman viikossa tai pyykkiä ei ole lainkaan. Palveluntarjoajan tulee nimetä sopimusasioista vastaava yhteyshenkilö sekä pesulatoiminnasta vastaava henkilö. Tehtävät voidaan osoittaa samalle henkilölle tai eri henkilöille. Yhteistyöpalavereita järjestetään tarvittaessa. Laskuilla tulee eritellä liinavaatteiden pesupalvelut ja muiden tekstiilien pesupalvelut erikseen. Sopimus tulee voimaan 1.1.2027 ja on voimassa toistaiseksi.,

title: Netherlands – Bicycles – EA Bedrijfsfietsen en handhavingsfietsen Gemeente Zwolle
description: De gemeente Zwolle sluit voor deze opdracht per perceel een Raamovereenkomst met één Opdrachtnemer. De Raamovereenkomsten hebben betrekking op de levering van fietsen in eigendom van de gemeente en het bijbehorende onderhoud, reparatie en service. Lease- en huurconstructies maken geen onderdeel uit van deze aanbesteding. De aanbesteding bestaat uit twee afzonderlijk te gunnen percelen: Perceel 1 – Handhavingsfietsen Dit perceel betreft de levering van handhavingsfietsen, waaronder robuuste fietsen zoals mountainbikes en elektrische varianten, die worden ingezet bij de uitvoering van toezicht- en handhavingstaken. Perceel 2 – Bedrijfsfietsen Dit perceel betreft de levering van elektrische en niet-elektrische bedrijfsfietsen. Deze fietsen worden ingezet als functioneel vervoermiddel ter ondersteuning van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden, met name voor korte dienstreizen en verplaatsingen tussen locaties. Omvang Perceel 1 – Handhavingsfietsen De geraamde opdrachtwaarde bedraagt € 156.392, - exclusief btw over de maximale looptijd van vier jaar. Om beperkte volumewijzigingen gedurende de looptijd te kunnen opvangen, wordt voor de reguliere scope een maximale opdrachtwaarde van € 195.490, - exclusief btw gehanteerd. Daarnaast is de volgende herzieningsmogelijkheid voorzien: Uitbreiding handhavingsfietsen: als gevolg van personele wijzigingen, veranderingen in mobiliteitsbeleid of organisatorische verschuivingen kan sprake zijn van uitbreiding met maximaal tien (10) handhavingsfietsen. De maximale financiële omvang van deze uitbreiding bedraagt € 56.000, - exclusief btw, bestaande uit maximaal € 50.000, - voor aanschaf en € 6.000, - voor onderdelen en onderhoud. Daarmee bedraagt de maximale financiële omvang voor Perceel 1 inclusief deze herzieningsmogelijkheid € 251.490, - exclusief btw. Omvang Perceel 2 – Bedrijfsfietsen De geraamde opdrachtwaarde bedraagt € 292.916, - exclusief btw over de maximale looptijd van vier jaar. Om beperkte volumewijzigingen gedurende de looptijd te kunnen opvangen, wordt voor de reguliere scope een maximale opdrachtwaarde van € 366.145, - exclusief btw gehanteerd. Daarnaast zijn de volgende herzieningsmogelijkheden voorzien: Uitbreiding elektrische bedrijfsfietsen: bij vervanging van reguliere bedrijfsfietsen kan gedurende de looptijd worden gekozen voor uitbreiding met maximaal vijftien (15) elektrische bedrijfsfietsen. De maximale financiële omvang hiervan bedraagt € 67.200, - exclusief btw, bestaande uit maximaal € 36.000, - voor aanschaf en € 31.200, - voor onderdelen en onderhoud. Uitbreiding elektrische bedrijfsfietsen in verband met dienstreizen: als gevolg van gewijzigd mobiliteitsbeleid kan voor een groep medewerkers behoefte ontstaan aan aanvullende elektrische fietsen. Hiervoor kan de vloot worden uitgebreid met maximaal twintig (20) elektrische bedrijfsfietsen. De maximale financiële omvang van deze uitbreiding bedraagt € 104.000, - exclusief btw. Daarmee bedraagt de maximale financiële omvang voor Perceel 2 inclusief deze herzieningsmogelijkheden € 537.345, - exclusief btw. De totale maximale financiële omvang van beide percelen gezamenlijk bedraagt daarmee € 788.835, - exclusief btw. De betreffende Raamovereenkomst eindigt uiterlijk na afloop van de maximale contractduur of eerder wanneer de voor het betreffende perceel geldende maximale opdrachtwaarde is bereikt.

Based on these submissions, a short-list of no more than six (6) firms will be selected for an interview. description: Предметът на обществената поръчка включва изпълнение на строително-монтажни работи и изготвяне на екзекутивна документация за обект: „Увеличаване на обема на долния изравнител на ПАВЕЦ „Чаира“ с изграждане на язовир „Яденица“ и реверсивен напорен тунел за връзка с язовир „Чаира“. Инжекционна галерия; Шахтов преливник с отводяща галерия, бързоток и енергогасител; Основен изпускател; Контролно измервателна система; Малка ВЕЦ на екологични води; Насип за укрепване на брега на язовирното езеро в зоната на Яденишки разлом; Укрепване на свлачище в района на временния взривен склад на площадка „Яденица“; Противоерозионна защита на ската над енергогасителя на язовирната стена до пътя за връзка с короната на стената; Противоерозионна защита на изкопни откоси на експлоатационен път по левия бряг на р. Яденица, участък от km 4+860 до km 5+770; Корекция на р. Яденица след язовирната стена; Присъединяване на постоянните съоръжения (потребители) към районна мрежа 20 kV в периода на експлоатация и резервни захранвания; • Реверсивен напорен тунел и прилежащи съоръжения с подобекти: Реверсивен напорен тунел; Входно съоръжение „Яденица“; Савачна шахта „Яденица“, Савачна шахта „Чаира“; Системи за пълнене и изпразване на тунела с апаратна камера и тунела за достъп до апаратна камера; Прозорец за достъп до реверсивен напорен тунел; Изместване на водопровод за ПАВЕЦ „Чаира“ от Манавско дере; • Експлоатационни пътища; • Обслужваща сграда; Система за физическа защита. Работният проект за изпълнението на обекта, с допълнителни указания относно ценообразуването и техническите изисквания ще бъдат предоставени с поканата за участие на допуснатите кандидати - за изготвяне на оферта.

These services include, but are not limited to, conducting root cause analysis of in-service failures, developing and updating preventative maintenance procedures, recommending design modifications to improve reliability, and providing on-site technical assistance to maintenance crews, etc. Government furnished equipment will be provided as outlined in individual task orders as necessary. The Contractor is responsible for providing, maintaining, and calibrating all support equipment required at their facility or a subcontractor�s facility. Contractor furnished material or parts used for replacement shall equal or exceed the quality of the original material or parts. The Government will not reimburse participants for any expenses associated with their participation in this survey. INSTRUCTIONS: This effort is for an 8a setaside. However, responses from disadvantaged small businesses not certified as 8a participants are encouraged to respond and will be considered on a case by case basis in accordance with current FAR regulations. Questions relative to this market survey should be addressed to the Program Manager (PM), Contract Specialist (CS), and Contracting Officer (CO). PURPOSE/DESCRIPTION The Government is conducting market research to identify potential sources that possess the facilities, expertise, capabilities, and experience to meet qualification requirements to complete R&M related tasks for helicopter platforms TH-1H, UH-1N, HH-60W and MH-139. This requirement is for engineering support services. Our strategy is a for five to ten-year cost plus fixed-fee contract (basic plus four to nine option years) and will potentially continue through FY37. Contractor�s facility must be located in the local area of Robins Air Force Base due to the need for frequent face to face reviews and collaborative efforts. The local facility must at a minimum accommodate the program management and technical writer personnel. Manufacturing and engineering labs can be located elsewhere if necessary. When tasked by the Government, the Contractor shall perform analyses and/or services which include but are not limited to engineering research, rapid solutions, prototypes, integration and technical support services required to isolate and analyze system deficiencies, identification of appropriate solutions and production of all engineering data required to implement the improvements to prevent an adverse impact to rotary-wing aircraft reliability and maintainability. The tasking will be submitted via an Engineering Support Task Request (ESTR) form. Examples of tasks that will be required on this contract include, but are not limited to: Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) and Age Exploration (AE) program sustainment tasks such as maintenance data trend analysis, failure mode and effects analysis updates, preventative maintenance package task updates, AE candidate follow-up and updating existing RCM databases Targeted Analyses which would include failure analysis, follow- up analysis, and independent technical reviews The contractor shall provide engineering and technical expertise in support of avionics systems, aircraft structures, into existing helicopter systems for modernization to improve performance, reliability, maintainability, and survivability of weapon systems, subsystems, and the support equipment develop and provide prototypes, pre-production items, or one-time production items in quantities as specified in the ESTR to allow for testing by both the contractor and Government. The contractor shall provide prototypes, pre-production units, or one-time production units, conduct tests and evaluate the item(s) against specified requirements, and deliver an industry-validated technical documentation package modification/changes/updates to engineering drawing packages, technical orders (TO), Flight Manuals and time compliance technical orders (TCTO) provide engineering and technical installation services to support trial install/kit proof activities as they apply to reliability and maintainability investigate failure modes for low Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF) components and develop/recommend solutions to improve MTBF via component redesign, material changes and/or maintenance practice changes POCs for this RFI are: Michelle Privette, Program Manager (michelle.privette@us.af.mil) Phillip Russell, Contracting Officer (phillip.russell.9@us.af.mil) Brent Talbert, Contract Specialist (brent.talbert@us.af.mil) RFI responses are due 4 November 2026, 5:00pm EST

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Hochwasserschutz Herzberg SE3p, Teilobjekt 1, Bauabschnitte 1 bis 3 rechts (BA1-3re), Umweltbaubegleitung
description: Der Planfeststellungsbeschluss für die Herstellung des Hochwasserschutzes (HWS) der Ortslage Herzberg (Elster) Teilobjekt 1 liegt seit August 2023 vor. Auf der linken Seite der Schwarzen Elster wurden seit 2024 die Bauabschnitte 1 und 4 fertiggestellt. Derzeit werden die Bauabschnitte 2 und 3 bis Ende 2027 umgesetzt. Ab Oktober 2026 werden auf der rechten Seite die Abschnitte 1 bis 3 "BA1-3re" über 2 Jahre begonnen. Die Baukosten sind mit ca. 5 Mio. EUR veranschlagt. Die Hochwasserschutzanlage wird größtenteils als freistehende Spundwand realisiert. In kürzeren Bereichen ist die Spundwand überdeckt bzw. wird ein DIN-gerechter Erddeich errichtet. Gemäß Vorgaben der Planfeststellung sind die Baumaßnahmen durch eine ökologische Bauüberwachung (= Umweltbaubegleitung UBB) zu begleiten. Die UBB soll mit dieser Vergabe vertraglich gebunden werden. Inhalt der Leistung sind die Überwachung der Durchführung der im Landschaftspflegerischen Begleitplan (LBP) festgelegten Schutz-, Vermeidungs- und trassennahen Kompensationsmaßnahmen. Die Überwachung eingriffsferner Kompensationsmaßnahmen nach § 39 HOAI sind nicht Bestandteil dieser Vergabe. Diese Maßnahmen wurden ab Anfang 2022 umgesetzt und befinden sich bis Ende 2026 in der Entwicklungs-, anschließend in der Unterhaltungspflege.

title: F138-100 engine sustainment
description: 1. Purpose This is a Sources Sought Synopsis issued for market research purposes only. This notice is not a solicitation, request for proposal, request for quotation, invitation for bid, or commitment by the Government to award a contract. The Government will not pay for any information, costs, or responses submitted in response to this notice. No solicitation is available at this time, and the Government does not intend to award a contract based solely on responses to this announcement. The Government may contact respondents to obtain additional information regarding their capabilities. 2. Requirement Description The Department of the Air Force is conducting market research to identify capable sources for a potential follow-on requirement for F138-100 engine sustainment supporting C-5M aircraft mission requirements. The current F138-100 Engine Sustainment contract is an indefinite delivery, indefinite-quantity service contract. The current contract was competitively awarded to Canadian Commercial Corporation. The anticipated requirement may include material management, engine maintenance, component support, engineering, airworthiness, and related sustainment services. The Government has not determined the acquisition strategy, contract type, period of performance, competition approach, or socioeconomic set-aside approach for any future requirement. 3. Anticipated Scope Interested parties should demonstrate their capability to perform some or all of the following functions: Provide material-management functions, engine maintenance, and subcontractor component-support services. Provide supply liaison support and depot-level maintenance and repair capability, including required equipment and tooling. Develop and update maintenance build plans using Reliability Centered Maintenance Plus principles. Comply with applicable Technical Order data and Time Compliance Technical Orders, including new or revised technical requirements. Support engineering investigations. Support Product Quality Deficiency Reports. Provide analytical condition inspections. Manage and use Government-furnished property, including Government-owned parts and equipment, as authorized and made available by the Government. Support and maintain certifications and compliance associated with airworthiness requirements. Integrate and coordinate peculiar support equipment. 4. Requested Capability Information Interested parties are requested to submit a concise capabilities statement addressing the following: a. Company Information Company name. Unique Entity Identifier. Commercial and Government Entity code, if available. Company address. Primary point of contact, including name, title, telephone number, and email address. Applicable NAICS codes listed in the company�s System for Award Management registration. Business size and socioeconomic status for NAICS 336412, including, as applicable: Small business; Small disadvantaged business; 8(a) participant; Women-owned small business; Economically disadvantaged women-owned small business; HUBZone small business; Service-disabled veteran-owned small business; Veteran-owned small business; or Other than small business. b. Technical Capability A description of the company�s capability to meet each anticipated scope area identified in Section 3. Identification of any scope areas the company cannot perform. Description of facilities, equipment, tooling, technical data access, quality systems, certifications, and workforce qualifications relevant to F138-100 or comparable military/commercial aircraft engine sustainment. Description of experience supporting airworthiness, technical-order compliance, engineering investigations, product quality deficiency reporting, and analytical condition inspections. c. Relevant Experience For each relevant effort performed within the past five years, provide: Customer name and contract number, if releasable; Period of performance; Brief description of work performed; Relevance to the anticipated requirement; Contract value or value range, if releasable; Prime contractor or subcontractor role; and Customer point of contact, if authorized for release. d. Teaming and Subcontracting Respondents proposing to use teaming arrangements or subcontractors should identify: Proposed prime contractor and each known teammate or subcontractor; Anticipated roles and scope allocation; Whether each entity is small or other than small business; Relevant prior teaming experience; and Any limitations, dependencies, or approvals affecting the arrangement. e. Small-Business Participation All respondents are requested to provide a reasonable estimate of anticipated small-business utilization as a percentage of total contract value, with supporting rationale. Identify the anticipated supplies or services suitable for small-business participation and the socioeconomic categories expected to be utilized. If a small business intends to compete as a prime contractor under a potential small-business set-aside, it should describe its planned approach to complying with applicable limitations on subcontracting, including: The anticipated percentage of contract performance to be performed by the prime contractor and similarly situated entities; The anticipated percentage of payments to be made to subcontractors that are not similarly situated entities; The anticipated division of work among teaming partners and subcontractors; and The basis for concluding that the proposed performance approach is achievable. Other than small businesses should also describe their anticipated approach to small-business subcontracting and their experience meeting small-business subcontracting commitments on comparable efforts. 5. Acquisition Strategy The Government has not determined an acquisition strategy for this potential requirement. Information received in response to this notice will be used to assess the availability and capability of industry sources and to inform potential competition and small-business participation strategies. The Government may consider full and open competition, a socioeconomic set-aside, or another acquisition approach, as appropriate. Nothing in this notice constitutes a commitment by the Government regarding any future acquisition strategy.
